intent: Face or initials for a person (circle) or an organisation (square). Not a status chip and not a button.
useWhen: Which mark: Avatar is a person or an organisation. Circle for people, square for organisations.
customer or workspace in a table row — shape square
doNotUseWhen: status or category chips — use Badge
brand logos from a file — use LogoStrip or ask first

size.note: xs 20 (12/16 caption, dense table), sm 24 (14/20 table row), md 32 (two-line list), lg 40 (card or page header), xl 48 (profile header). Breaking: sm, md and lg were 32, 40 and 48; use md, lg and xl for the old sizes.

shape.note: circle for people, square for organisations (customers, vendors, workspaces). Square corners: xs and sm radius.sm, md radius.md, lg and xl radius.lg.

presence.note: A corner mark with its own shape (solid, half, hollow) and a surface.card ring. The word (KitLabels online, away, offline) joins the accessible name, e.g. Ana Ruiz, Online. Also say it in visible text nearby, e.g. Online · ana@acme.com.

requirements: when image shows, img alt=name (plus the presence word when set)
when fallback, role=img and aria-label=name (plus the presence word when set)
Presence mark is aria-hidden; its word is in the name and its shape differs per state, so colour is never the only signal
presence words come from KitLabelsProvider (online, away, offline); English by default

doNot: do not make Avatar clickable without a new contract
do not add a count or status Badge on Avatar; presence is the only corner mark
do not show presence by colour alone; keep the word in visible text nearby
do not use Badge for people
do not use a circle for an organisation or a square for a person
snippet:
<Avatar name="Boris Jovanovic" size="md" />
<Avatar name="Ana Ruiz" size="md" presence="online" />
<Avatar name="Northwind Traders" size="sm" shape="square" />
